plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Pete Worden, a space scientist, introduced Tom DeLonge, a rock musician who became a UFO campaigner, to Neil McCasland, a US Air Force general, sometime in the 2010s. Michels says this is public information. He tells it to show links between people pushing for UFO openness and senior military figures.
